bead.title: claude-tui/step9: performance ratchet vs claude — wall-time-per-turn + cost-per-task comparison
bead.description:
concerns.md (testing concern §Performance ratchets) requires <1ms loop overhead and <10ms beyond inference per agent-loop iteration. ADR-013 also flags performance as a known concern: frame-derived parsing is more expensive than stream-json JSONL parsing on long turns. This bead lands the comparison.

WORK:
- Add a claude-tui lane to scripts/benchmark/ that runs the same prompt against claude --print and PTY+hooks-driven claude.
- Capture per-turn wall time, total prompt-to-final latency, loop overhead (turn-time minus model-inference time as reported in usage), and reported cost (subscription vs metered).
- Persist a benchmark fixture under benchmark-results/claude-tui-ratchet/ with the comparison.
- Add a unit test that asserts the loop-overhead ratchet: claude-tui's measured overhead per turn (excluding model time) is within the documented bound (<10ms per testing concern, OR <2x claude --print baseline, whichever is looser).

NON-SCOPE: long-turn benchmark scenarios (covered by general benchmark suite); subscription-vs-API cost computation (covered by GATE fizeau-a45dafe6 + benchmark cost reporting).
bead.acceptance:
1) scripts/benchmark/ has a claude-tui lane that runs equivalent prompts against claude (--print baseline) and claude-tui (PTY+hooks).
2) Benchmark output captures per-turn wall time, total latency, loop overhead, and reported cost (with billing classification per the cost concern).
3) benchmark-results/claude-tui-ratchet/ contains a baseline fixture with at least three runs of each mode.
4) A go test asserts the loop-overhead ratchet from the testing concern: claude-tui per-turn overhead beyond inference is <10ms OR within 2x of claude --print baseline (whichever is looser); test failure includes the measured values so regressions are diagnosable.
5) The ratchet test runs in CI by default (not behind a build tag) using a recorded fixture; live benchmark runs are opt-in via a harness_integration tag.
6) go test ./scripts/benchmark/... -count=1 green; go test ./... -count=1 green.
